input: Research remote cabin rentals for a digital detox weekend

gold.taskTitle: Research Remote Cabin Rentals for a Digital Detox Weekend
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate remote cabin rental options suited for a screen-free, disconnected weekend getaway.

questions.title: How many people are joining this weekend trip?
questions.description: Clarify the group size to filter cabins by sleeping capacity and amenities.

questions.title: What is your target travel month or specific weekend?
questions.description: Identify the intended dates to check availability and account for seasonal pricing or conditions.

questions.title: What is your maximum budget for the entire rental?
questions.description: Establish a clear price ceiling to narrow down suitable options.

questions.title: Which geographic region or state should the cabin be in?
questions.description: Pinpoint the preferred location or proximity to a departure city to focus the search.

questions.title: How far are you willing to drive from home?
questions.description: Define the maximum acceptable travel distance to filter out options that are too remote to reach conveniently.

questions.title: Which non-digital amenities matter most to you?
questions.description: Identify must-have features such as a fireplace, hot tub, hiking access, or a lake view to prioritize matching cabins.

questions.title: Should the cabin have zero cell service, or just no Wi-Fi?
questions.description: Clarify the exact level of disconnection desired, as this directly determines which locations qualify as a true digital detox.
